name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Rover goes with at most one of Electrical, Concrete, and Multimeter.
Hertz, Rover, and Laser belong to different engineers.
Diesel goes with exactly two of Robotics, Skyscraper, Aluminum, and Multimeter.
Civil goes with exactly three of Watt, Rover, Concrete, and Laser.
Hertz, Civil, and Multimeter belong to different engineers.
Skyscraper goes with either Civil or Titanium (but not both).
